findings.title: Java 8 build/runtime must move to Java 21
findings.current: Java 8 source/target and EAP OpenJDK 8 image
findings.evidence: build.gradle declares VERSION_1_8; Dockerfile image is eap73-openjdk8.
findings.migration_impact: Align build compiler and runtime; source has not been tested on Java 21.
findings.automation_potential: HIGH for settings; MEDIUM for validation
findings.recommended_remediation: Set Java 21 compatibility/toolchain after verifying Gradle and runtime; build and run on the target JDK.
findings.validation: Run clean build on Java 21 and start the target container.

findings.title: Gradle wrapper 8.4 requires Java 21 compatibility verification
findings.target: Retain or update wrapper based on Java 21 build evidence
findings.evidence: distributionUrl pins gradle-8.4-bin.zip; no Java 21 build was run.
findings.migration_impact: Toolchain incompatibility could prevent target build.
findings.recommended_remediation: Test wrapper 8.4 with the selected JDK; upgrade only if required by build evidence or policy.

findings.title: Java EE API dependency must be replaced with Jakarta EE 10 API
findings.evidence: Version catalog declares Java EE aggregate API and build places it in providedCompile.
findings.migration_impact: Old API namespaces cannot serve as target Jakarta API.
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace version catalog coordinate with approved Jakarta EE 10 API while retaining provided scope.
findings.validation: Inspect resolved graph and WAR to ensure target API compiles and is not bundled.

findings.title: Application bean imports use javax namespace
findings.current: Twelve javax.enterprise, javax.inject and javax.faces imports in five files
findings.evidence: Repository import scan found twelve javax EE imports across all five view beans and no jakarta imports.
findings.migration_impact: Mixed namespaces can prevent CDI/Faces linkage.
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace imports with corresponding jakarta packages and verify CDI names/scopes.
findings.validation: Compile; confirm every named bean resolves on EAP 8.1.

findings.title: Web, CDI and JBoss descriptors require target validation/conversion
findings.current: Java EE web 4.0, CDI beans 1.1 and JBoss web schema 7.2
findings.target: Jakarta EE descriptors accepted by EAP 8.1
findings.evidence: Current namespaces, schemas, Faces names and root context are declared in these descriptors.
findings.migration_impact: Stale schemas/classes can block startup; root context must remain.
findings.automation_potential: HIGH for literals; MEDIUM for schema/runtime validation
findings.recommended_remediation: Convert descriptors, retain CDI annotated mode, URL mapping, multipart limits and context root.
findings.validation: Deploy and inspect logs; test root route, Faces servlet and CDI.

findings.title: PrimeFaces baseline must move through the documented staged path
findings.evidence: Version catalog and eight staged migration definitions/report pairs.
findings.migration_impact: Eight version transitions can affect component tags, APIs and client resources.
findings.automation_potential: HIGH for version edits; MEDIUM for API changes
findings.recommended_remediation: Use PF 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and 15 stages with QA gates.
findings.validation: Build and test each stage before proceeding.

findings.title: UploadedFile API package changes for PrimeFaces 15
findings.evidence: Actual import/type locations and target package called out in repository skill.
findings.migration_impact: Stale type or methods can fail compilation/upload.
findings.automation_potential: HIGH for import; MEDIUM for method/API validation
findings.recommended_remediation: Update package and validate PF 15 file methods and listener signature.
findings.validation: Compile and perform end-to-end file upload.

findings.title: Calendar component is a staged deprecation/migration concern
findings.current: p:calendar with pattern, showOn and dateSelect
findings.target: p:datePicker where required by target stages
findings.evidence: Current component is used in Elements page; stage assessments identify calendar transition.
findings.migration_impact: Date formatting, popup and AJAX selection can change.
findings.recommended_remediation: Check stage taglib and migrate when required; preserve date pattern and update behavior.
findings.validation: Select, submit and display date; verify AJAX summary.

findings.title: Growl component requires compatibility check or replacement
findings.evidence: Growl and messages are both present; PF14 report identifies growl deprecation/removal.
findings.automation_potential: HIGH for markup; human behavior test
findings.recommended_remediation: Apply target-supported messages pattern only after verifying release taglib.
findings.validation: Trigger validation and action messages; verify visibility and no duplicates.

findings.title: PrimeFaces component and CSS regression surface requires staged validation
findings.current: Tables, upload, exporter, editor, AJAX, dialog, autocomplete, date and custom styles
findings.target: Components and styles compatible with each target release
findings.evidence: Actual component usage and 412-line CSS file; prior stage reports identify UI behavior changes.
findings.migration_impact: Runtime/taglib errors and visual or interaction regressions.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use a per-stage UI regression checklist and inspect target taglib/API.
findings.validation: Test all five pages; test upload/export/editor/table/date/AJAX; browser console and visuals.

findings.title: EAP 7.3 container must be replaced and EAP 8.1 access confirmed
findings.evidence: Current image and deployment paths are explicit; target image is declared by repository skill.
findings.migration_impact: Entitlement, architecture, filesystem or runtime mismatch can prevent deploy.
findings.recommended_remediation: Confirm approved target image, access and image conventions; update Docker/Compose consistently.
findings.validation: Build/start image, inspect logs, verify root WAR and port 8080.

findings.title: Linux target is configured to amd64 pending target image verification
findings.target: Supported platform(s) of approved EAP 8.1 image
findings.evidence: Dockerfile and Compose declare amd64; target image manifest has not been checked.
findings.migration_impact: No ARM-native/multi-architecture readiness can be assumed.
findings.recommended_remediation: Confirm target manifest and build/run on intended Linux architecture.
findings.validation: Inspect image manifest and run container on target host.

findings.title: No automated behavioral test coverage is present
files: Repository; no src/test or CI files found
findings.current: No test framework, test source tree or tracked CI pipeline
findings.evidence: Repository inventory; shell validators cover modernization checks, not UI behavior.
findings.migration_impact: Behavioral regressions may escape compile-only checks.
findings.recommended_remediation: Require manual QA gates for every stage; consider tests only as separately approved scope.
findings.validation: Record all-page regression evidence for each version and final EAP deployment.

findings.title: Optional private PrimeFaces JAR can override resolved module
findings.target: Verified PF 15.0.16 Jakarta artifact if override is retained
findings.evidence: Gradle conditionally selects local file; no versioned PF JAR is tracked.
findings.migration_impact: Build may use stale, wrong-version or non-Jakarta artifact.
findings.recommended_remediation: Inspect local artifact source/version/classifier; retain only verified target artifact.
findings.validation: Inspect resolved dependency and WAR contents.
